original_title: The File menu works under the modal Add-Wallet wizard
disposition: confirmed public File-command/page-navigation variant fixed; OS-native event/platform matrix not established

actual_parent.impact: The same MenuCommand used by the native File menu changes the underlying selected page while the Add-Wallet form remains owned by its modal. Exact draft/selection and zero creation/close-effect oracles are retained.

result: One typed root admission binding disables all relevant native File/page commands and guards final direct routes; shutdown remains available. Existing admitted operations/receipts remain model-owned.

The introduced inline node-shell route failed the existing Qt6.4 Core/UI Settings oracle; ordinary external typed app component preserves the route. Exact original production baseline passes; final current public button signal/page oracle passes. No upstream Qt defect cause is claimed.
limits: No demonstrated incorrect payment, unrecoverable wallet data or process failure is alleged.
Backup/error and PSBT-overlay consequences are not separately reproduced as new funds/data defects; the shared File admission mechanism prevents new covered File actions during owned modality.
